mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Read the uploaded RFP file (PDF/Word), extract text, and convert it into a structured tabular format (e.g., sections, subsections, key phrases). Store the result in a JSON or CSV for downstream analysis.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A structured dataset containing RFP sections and extracted text ready for parsing.

units.description: From the structured RFP data, identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, performance SLAs, audit requirements). Output a list of criteria with brief descriptions and any associated reference numbers.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A table or JSON array of mandatory compliance criteria with identifiers.

units.description: Using the compliance criteria list, create a tiered labor cost model (e.g., Tier 1: core migration, Tier 2: security hardening, Tier 3: ongoing support). Assign realistic hourly rates and estimate effort per criterion. Produce a summary table of total projected costs.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A cost model spreadsheet or JSON detailing labor tiers, rates, effort estimates, and aggregate totals.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that includes: an executive summary, solution overview, compliance traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed approach and cost tier, and a brief implementation roadmap. Use the outputs from t2 and t3 for accuracy.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2, t3]
units.output_contract: A complete proposal document (Markdown/Word format) with embedded traceability matrix and pricing summary.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes mandatory technical compliance criteria extraction, multi‑tier labor pricing modeling, and a traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The user has provided an uploaded document (the RFP). The workflow requires: ingesting and structuring the RFP content; extracting all mandatory technical compliance items; building a tiered labor cost model based on those requirements; and finally assembling a proposal that references each requirement with traceability. This is a multi‑step analytical and creative task, so we split it into four distinct phases, each with clear dependencies.
